unreleased.label: 0.4.49 development test build
unreleased.rangeNote: Modern Co-op/Character menu, original customizable avatars and reliable appearance sync; protocol 7 requires both players to update. Complete story and two-account Internet validation remain pending.

bullets: Modern Co-op and Character pages keep the native Multiplayer entry. A rotating 3D preview offers face, skin, hair, outerwear, colors and accessories with explicit Apply/Discard and saved profiles.

Auto uses an original skinned winter traveler across gameplay and the additive Office typing world. Reliable session/revision-checked catalog messages share live edits; explicit legacy avatar overrides retain their own visuals.

Preview rendering waits for Unity skinning after a geometry change, preventing blank portraits. Changed meshes and preview resources are released; unchanged profiles avoid rebuilds and settings parsing.

873 managed/log checks and two native helper suites pass. Same-DLL TCP-only and TCP+UDP routes cover all ten build scenes, with visible menu/remote-body graphics checks and zero mod runtime errors. Full story and two-account Spacewar testing remain pending.

groups.section: Earlier menu, join and parity repairs
bullets: Multiplayer text sits above Episodes using the native font and spacing; the Canvas tab has Host/Join, LAN/Spacewar, lobby copying, Back and Start story. Main-menu diagnostics are opt-in.

Directional walk/run/backward/strafe, breathing, crouch, seating, airborne tuck, head aim and held-item hand targets use the sequenced pose stream. Procedural clones have a neutral base and independent animation ownership.
Grounded foot correction prevents crouch sinking; inactive cinematic controllers no longer imply airborne poses. The janitor broom is removed from player clones.

Regression probes exercise native Host/Join actions and the actual skinned skeletons; optional graphics capture records menu/pose images. Native crashes and out-of-memory reports remain test failures.

Spacewar waits for real peer packets; disconnect reasons survive cleanup and follow the current Host/Join role in Multiplayer. Closed lobby IDs cannot be copied. Stale host workers cannot close replacement connections. The tester-reported two-PC failure needs a fresh retest.
Thirty selected Cabin story fields gain native-value digest checks; per-update lookup reuse reduces repeated scene searches. Both-PC log collection records actual installed DLL/helper hashes.

Previous 0.4.48 validation: 688 managed/log checks and two native helper suites pass. Final same-DLL headless TCP-only and TCP+UDP sweeps pass all ten scenes, native menu/animation probes and matching 15/30-field Cabin digests. Full story, full graphics and two-account Spacewar retest remain pending.
Exact adapters and runtime inventory cover the ten shipped build scenes; the paired crawler verifies snapshots, rigs, additive Office return, typing words and RoadTrip seating.
Office/Parking/RoadTrip select native human rigs; pizza-box clone paths now match the host.
Credits and the typing game mirror host presentation with bounded binary payloads; client suppression leaves host scripts enabled.
Native crouch and audio-fade lifecycle guards prevent missing-reference callbacks without replacing game files.
Dynamic pedestrian pools now use host prefab/slot/count inventories; client random spawns cannot stall the Office additive snapshot.
Earlier 0.4.47 validation: 530 automated checks and same-DLL TCP-only/TCP+UDP sweeps passed across all ten build scenes; full story/visual and two-account Spacewar validation remain pending.
Body/stance/velocity and hand targets travel in scene/session/sequence-scoped poses; head/torso aim and arm IK apply after Animator evaluation.
Spacewar adds isolated App ID 480 two-player lobbies and Steam P2P/relay with F11 lobby IDs; LAN remains default.
Fixed scene-destroyed avatar roots, duplicate application counters, frame-rate-dependent pose sending and silent send failures; expanded regression and headless diagnostics.
Scene-model remote avatars restore body renderers inherited disabled from suppressed NPCs; hidden story props remain hidden.
The oven casserole follows the host's actual visibility and transform during board games.
F10 and automatic scene dumps include remote-avatar renderer counts for diagnosis.
Failed or incomplete snapshots keep the session out of Live and trigger full-state retries, including Office and ParkingLot caches.
Smoke checks parse current applied-state counters and require host/client gameplay evidence; stale logs and menu-only runs cannot pass.
The download now contains the stated DLL version with loader files at archive root, a build manifest, and checksums.
The whole opening plays together: the drive in, the hiker at the window, cooking, and the Jenga + Ouija mini-games all stay in sync.
Mike and every cabin character — the hiker, Nora, the cat — move and act the same on both screens.
Now covers the dark return-to-cabin run, not just the first visit.
Mike drives in and the whole order plays out shared — the booth, the pizza, the phone, the truck.
Mike now hands off cleanly the whole visit through — driving in, parking, sitting, eating, grabbing the pizza, leaving.
The cashier, the hobo, the hiker and the box-folding worker are all synced.
The full highway drive is shared — the radio, the deer, the school bus and the final conversation hit both players at the same time.
You can now ride together: the second player buckles into the back of the truck (press F12). Early, but it's in.
Desks, the computers and their on-screen windows, the coffee machine, vending, fridge and bathrooms all stay in sync.
The office workers and the janitor act the same for both players.
The phone call, the elevator and the parking-lot beats are shared.
The stranger, Mike and the walking cop are synced.
You see each other as real in-game characters with name tags, not floating capsules.
The host now waits for the second player during loading screens, so you stay together through every scene change.
Built-in F11 menu to host or join — no config files to touch.
Office and Parking Lot added; deeper Cabin, Pizzeria and Road Trip coverage; in-game host/join menu; real player avatars with name tags.
Full join handshake so the second player loads straight into the host's exact state; Cabin characters and mini-games synced.
First working co-op: host and client connect, scenes sync, world / doors / dialogue mirror between both players.
Initial build: host and spectator, scene and camera sync.
